CI.thesis: A deleveraging managed-care and PBM franchise with ROIC rising to 13.4% and a 12.29% FCF yield trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a -16% revenue decline that reaffirmed guidance does not support.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 9%, giving up the five-year improvement from 8.8% to 13.4%.
TTM operating margin falls below 3.5%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 3.7%, showing PBM reform or medical-cost pressure is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM net margin falls below 1.5%, near the FY2024 trough of 1.4%, confirming margin compression is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below 2.5%, under the five-year low of 3.1%, signalling earnings quality and buyback capacity are deteriorating.

DECK.thesis: A net-cash, 90%-ROIC footwear brand owner trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 10% FCF yield with 5.7% annual buybacks, which prices in a margin collapse that the fundamentals do not yet show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, below the FY2024 level of 55.6%, signalling competitive or promotional pressure is eroding brand pricing power.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 70%, indicating brand-moat economics are deteriorating.

GDDY.thesis: A deleveraging, 37%-ROIC, 33%-FCF-margin domain and SMB-software franchise trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 13.7% FCF yield, pricing a litigation-driven bookings scare that its reported numbers do not yet show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% to 37.3%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash-generation gains were promotional or transitory.
Total bookings growth in the SEC 8-K earnings release falls below 4% y/y for two consecutive quarters, showing the promotional-discount allegations reflect a real demand problem.

HKG:2076.thesis: China's leading direct-chat recruitment platform, with net cash, a 50.9% FCF margin and accelerating 14.1% revenue growth, trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple at a 9.28% FCF yield, pricing a China/VIE discount that its fundamentals do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 16.0%, showing the AI-matching and network-effect cost advantage has eroded.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2023 five-year low of 82.2%, signalling pricing or competitive pressure on employer paid services.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2023 level of 35.1%, showing the cash-generation step-up was transitory.
Reported quarterly revenue (company release / income statement) declines YoY for two consecutive quarters, ending the growth acceleration seen in Q2 2026 (+14.1%).

HKG:9999.thesis: A net-cash, high-margin game developer with five years of rising returns trades below its own 5-year EV/EBITDA and P/FCF minimums and at a 9.86% FCF yield, which prices in a regulatory overhang rather than the quality it has delivered.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating the game portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in an SEC 20-F/6-K filing.

HRB.thesis: A 23%-operating-margin, high-ROIC assisted tax-prep leader trades in the bottom fifth of its own 5-year multiples at a 13.92% FCF yield, where the price implies a -15.4% revenue decline that guided growth and 6% annual share shrinkage do not support.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 43%, breaking the five-year low (44.3% TTM, 44.3%-45.7% FY range), signalling price pressure from free/AI filing alternatives.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, under the five-year low of 21.5% (FY2022), showing the margin expansion has reversed.
TTM FCF margin falls below 15%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 15.9%, meaning cash generation no longer funds the buyback and dividend.
Annual revenue (income statement) declines year on year for a full fiscal year, or management discloses a loss of assisted-category share, evidencing real displacement by free or DIY filing.

INTU.thesis: A net-cash, 40%-FCF-margin franchise with five years of rising ROIC and operating margin trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple and at an 11.2% FCF yield, pricing a guided FY2027 growth reset as a permanent impairment.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 15%, back to the FY2022 level, showing the returns expansion has reversed.
TTM operating margin falls below 23%, under the FY2024 level of 23.7%, showing AI/mid-market spending is not turning into efficiency.
TTM FCF margin falls below 29%, back to the FY2024 level, meaning the cash-generation step-up was transitory.

JKHY.thesis: A 22.7%-ROIC, 27.3%-FCF-margin core-banking franchise with multi-year contracts trades in the bottom decile of its own 5-year multiples, where the price implies just 0.4% growth against 7.3% delivered.

triggers.text: TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the 5-year rising trend (now 27.3%).
TTM net margin falls below 17%, under the FY2024 trough of 17.2%, signalling renewal price compression is biting.
TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
Annual revenue growth (income statement) falls below 5% for two consecutive fiscal years, undercutting the 7%-8% growth target.

OTIS.thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with 65% ROIC trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple at a 6.77% FCF yield, pricing a transitory service-margin squeeze and CEO transition as permanent impairment.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2%, showing the service-margin squeeze is structural, not transitory.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0%, showing cash generation is deteriorating with margins.
Service operating margin (earnings release) falls below 20% for two consecutive quarters, vs 23.2% in Q2 2026, or modernization backlog growth turns negative.

ZTS.thesis: A 27% ROIC, 38% operating-margin animal-health franchise trades below its own 5-year minimum multiples at a 7.86% FCF yield, pricing permanent erosion far larger than the single-digit guided earnings decline.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below the FY2022 5-year low of 69.7%, signalling structural loss of pricing power rather than cyclical volume softness.
TTM operating margin falls below the FY2023 5-year low of 35.9%, showing competition is eroding profitability, not just growth.
US companion-animal in-clinic share (dermatology), as reported on the earnings call, declines again in a second consecutive quarter beyond the -10pp YoY already seen.
Management cuts FY2026 adjusted net income guidance below the low end of the current 9%-5% decline range on the Q3 2026 call or later.
